question: Can the positive-component count of B_a intersect B_b be obtained from a speed/window integer-lattice formula, without constructing either runner's blocking-interval list or the pair-intersection intervals, and does that formula reproduce the frozen fewest-components selector?

frozen_candidate_lemma.domain: positive integer speeds a<b, one nondegenerate rational window J=[L,R], threshold delta=1/8, strict blocking B_v={t in J: ||v t||<delta}
frozen_candidate_lemma.lap_window_bounds: A lap label m for speed a can participate exactly when aL-delta < m < aR+delta; similarly bL-delta < n < bR+delta
frozen_candidate_lemma.lap_band: The two strict blocking laps overlap with positive length exactly when |b*m-a*n| < delta*(a+b)
frozen_candidate_lemma.count_claim: The number of positive connected components of B_a intersect B_b equals the number of integer lap pairs (m,n) satisfying both open window bounds and the open lap-band inequality
frozen_candidate_lemma.per_m_count: For each eligible integer m, set lower=max(bL-delta,(b*m-delta*(a+b))/a) and upper=min(bR+delta,(b*m+delta*(a+b))/a). The number of integer n with lower<n<upper is max(0,ceil(upper)-floor(lower)-1). Sum over m.
frozen_candidate_lemma.iteration_policy: Always use a<b and iterate only the candidate m labels of the smaller speed, in increasing order.
frozen_candidate_lemma.endpoint_policy: All inequalities are strict because blocking is strict and zero-length contacts are not positive components; threshold equality remains safe. Window endpoints may belong to a positive relative component but do not alter the strict lap-pair conditions.

frozen_decision_rule.eligibility: Use the already frozen condition C_0-O_cd>0 from archived total/single/pair moments.
frozen_decision_rule.selection: Among eligible base pairs, minimize the lap-band count; break an exact tie directly by physical-speed lexicographic order.
frozen_decision_rule.no_query: This investigation issues no new complement-containment query. After selection is fixed, compare only with the prior selector outcome and its archived containment result.
frozen_decision_rule.no_retuning: Do not add a score, secondary key, special case or alternate pair after seeing counts or archived outcomes.

calculation_order: Verify the protocol and pinned source hashes.
Read only windows, speeds and moment-derived eligibility; do not read archived pair components or selector choices.
Apply the lap-band formula to all 24 physical pairs, recording every candidate m row, open rational bounds and counted n labels.
Select from eligible pairs by the frozen rule.
Only after all formula counts and selections are fixed, compare with the archived component counts, interval-derived selector and containment outcomes.
Independently reconstruct blocking threshold events and components in a separately structured verifier.

scope.selector_charged_pairs: exactly the pairs with positive C_0-O_cd
forbidden: construct blocking-interval lists or pair-intersection intervals in the primary count
read archived component counts or selector choices before primary counts and selections are fixed
new speeds, windows, cores or references
uniform runtime, novelty, whole-configuration or general Lonely Runner claim

controls_and_limits: strict_16 tests an exact count tie and physical-speed lexicographic resolution.
doubling_112 remains a diagnostic after its pair-only-positive exit; formula selection does not replace that certificate.
tight_13 has no strictly positive-slack pair; its isolated equality t=3/8 remains separate from positive component counts.
The lemma may be supplied as an elementary proof candidate, but finite agreement is OBSERVED only and AI agreement is not independent mathematical validation.
The formula can still iterate speed-dependent lap labels. Avoid calling it constant-time, uniformly cheap, or better than the prior sparse arithmetic selector without a proved comparison.
